description: Size budgets checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs after BUNDLE_STATS=1 npx vite build. mainChunkMaxKB is the entry (index) chunk: game code only since Rapier moved to its own chunk (2026-11-22, with the Rapier 0.21 upgrade); it was 2700.1 KB with Rapier 0.13.1 inlined and is 633.2 KB without it. chunkBudgetsKB covers the physics engine: Rapier 0.21's WASM is 3.1 MB (1.5 MB in 0.13.1), base64-inlined once in the rapier chunk and once in the physics-worker bundle, so each went from about 2.1 MB to about 4.35 MB. A rule that matches no chunk fails the check.

chunkBudgetsKB.reason: @dimforge/rapier3d-compat (JS glue + inlined WASM); grows only when the dependency is upgraded
the worker bundles its own copy of Rapier plus the worker sim

forbiddenInMainChunk.reason: zone stamps load lazily via ZONE_LOADERS (src/zone-setup/registry.js)
the map editor is a lazy chunk (bootMapEditor import in init/core.ts)
full schema validation runs in CI and the editor only
Rapier ships in its own long-cached chunk (manualChunks in vite.config.js)
